page.layout: One printed page. Full-width opening paragraph in italic at top, with the heading "In LATINIS." and "In GRÆCIS." over two columns (Latin left, Greek right, separated by a vertical rule). Below the columns: signature "OO 3" at left and page number "320.I." at right. Handwritten "253" at top right is excluded. Faint show-through from the reverse side is excluded.

p.i: ANALECTA nostra habes: ERRATA minora addimus, siue ego calamo, siue typis operæ commiserunt. Sed ego me non pono extra culpam: & hoc certè pecco, quòd etsi correctè fortassè, parum bellè & expresse tamen scribo. Ignosce vtriuis nostrum, qui tibi alibi vis ignosci.

main_text.head: In GRÆCIS.
main_text.l: 119. ἕπεσθαι, pro ἕπεσθαι: & aliquoties sic in simili peccatum.
